title: Kubernetes: The Documentary [PART 1]
summary: The official Kubernetes documentary, part 1, tells how a handful of Google engineers, inspired by Docker's success, built a container orchestrator. It covers the internal resistance to open source and the competition of the container orchestrator wars.
why: Cited for the history of why containers and Kubernetes took off, though one thread critiqued the documentary itself.

quote.text: Fascinating documentary on Kubernetes for those who have 50 minutes.
